response.sql: WITH status_tally AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), stats AS (SELECT SUM(tally) as total_tally, COUNT(*) as num_statuses FROM status_tally), with_calculations AS (SELECT st.archstat, st.tally, CAST(st.tally AS FLOAT) / s.total_tally as share, CAST(st.tally AS FLOAT) / s.total_tally - 1.0 / s.num_statuses as above_average, 1.0 / s.num_statuses as avg_share FROM status_tally st CROSS JOIN stats s) SELECT archstat, tally, share, above_average FROM with_calculations WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY archstat
